$comment: Machine-readable contract for the Gatepath audit log. Both platforms load this file in their test suites and assert their writer's output conforms. Human-readable docs live in AUDIT_LOG_SCHEMA.md.
optional_fields_comment: Fields added after schema_version 1 was already in the wild. Writers on both platforms MUST emit them; readers MUST tolerate their absence, because log lines written before the field existed are still valid v1. Adding a field here is NOT a breaking change and does NOT bump schema_version — removing one, or changing a required field, would.

blocked_resource_requests.android: Count of resource sub-requests that matched a tracker domain. Observed via WebViewClient.shouldInterceptRequest; counted, allowed to load. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
blocked_resource_requests.desktop: Count of resource sub-requests that matched a tracker domain. Observed via WebKitGTK's resource-load-started signal; counted, allowed to load. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md. KNOWN GAP: always 0 in practice — the counters live in the portal_webview_runner subprocess and never reach the audit writer (session_controller.record_blocked_* is called only by tests).

blocked_navigation_attempts.android: Count of off-domain navigations the WebView observed (not in the portal host's same-origin set). Counted, allowed to load. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
blocked_navigation_attempts.desktop: Count of off-domain navigations the WebView observed. Counted, allowed to load. Field name retained for schema-version compatibility. See SECURITY_MODEL.md. KNOWN GAP: always 0 in practice — the counters live in the portal_webview_runner subprocess and never reach the audit writer (session_controller.record_blocked_* is called only by tests).

tls_cert_errors_bypassed.android: Count of TLS certificate errors the WebView was told to proceed past (WebViewClient.onReceivedSslError -> handler.proceed()). Only ever incremented for the portal host and its subdomains; cert errors on any other host are cancelled and NOT counted here. A non-zero value means the session rendered a page whose certificate did not validate. See SECURITY_MODEL.md.
tls_cert_errors_bypassed.desktop: Always 0 — but NOT because no bypass happens. As of the desktop TLS scoping work the WebView does proceed past certificate errors on the portal host (host-scoped, same rule as Android). The count cannot reach this field: the portal WebView runs in a separate subprocess (portal_webview_runner, spawned by the netns helper) and no channel carries its counters back to the audit writer. The same gap makes blocked_navigation_attempts and blocked_resource_requests always 0 on desktop — session_controller.record_blocked_* is never called in production. Until that channel exists, a desktop bypass is recorded only in the runner's log, not here.
